about: Paths the public distribution leaves out because their upstream terms do not permit an Apache-2.0 distribution that may be sold (terms that forbid sale). The public distribution carries only permissive third-party code (BSD, MIT, Apache-2.0, public domain) and US Government code (owner ruling 2026-10-14). UGWP is not held: by the owner ruling of 2026-10-14 NOAA GSL's UGWP and the RRFS fork's NOAA GSL physics are treated as US Government code, and the UGWP ports, their tests and oracles ship. The export filter removes every path below and every tier-list row naming a removed test; tools/licence_export.py applies and checks this. Private builds keep every held path. A hold is released only when its upstream states terms that permit redistribution and sale, or by a project ruling; release it by deleting its entry. Paths are relative to the distribution root. The runtime half is src/hexcore/data/profiles/licence-gates.v1.json: no default selects held code, and a run that selects it must opt in by naming its terms.

holds.upstream: https://github.com/NCAR/noahmp, as MPAS-Model v8.4.2 carries it in src/core_atmosphere/physics/physics_noahmp
holds.reason: The terms say: 'You shall not sell, license or transfer for a fee the Software, or any work that in any manner contains the Software.' Apache-2.0 grants the right to sell, and the public distribution must stay sellable (owner ruling 2026-10-14), so the hex port of Noah-MP v5.0 and everything that carries or derives from it stay in private builds.
holds.release_when: never on the current terms: UCAR would have to grant terms that permit sale, or a project ruling settles it
holds.native_backend: unaffected: config_lsm_backend='native-cpu' runs Noah-MP from the user's own MPAS build, and only with --licence-opt-in ucar-noahmp
holds.refusal: the forecast door refuses config_lsm_scheme='sf_noahmp' on an MPAS suite without --licence-opt-in ucar-noahmp, naming the terms and the permissive WRF-lineage Noah-MP v4.x of the WOOF suite; with the opt-in it refuses the hex-cuda backend in a distribution without the port by naming this hold (hexcore.licence_gate)
